notes.title: Advanced(R-stick) Rotation added / Fixed Stage 1-7 Loading Issue
notes.content:
1. New Gunship Rotation Control Option: Advanced(R-stick) Rotation added

With the feedback from flight simulation loving players, we are adding new control option for the advanced players.
Now you can select [Advanced(R-stick) Rotation] from the Options Menu to rotate the gunship using the R-stick.

*Warning: Default control option [Head-Movement Rotation] is the optimized rotation control option to reduce VR nausea.
[Head-Movement Rotation] stimulate player’s rotation sensory with head tilt movement to reduce the nausea caused from free rotation in VR.
We recommend every player to use [Head-Movement Rotation].
[Advanced(R-stick) Rotation] is only recommended for flight simulation lovers and advanced VR users who want immersion over comfort.
[Advanced(R-stick) Rotation] can cause nausea if the player doesn’t have a lot of experience in VR.


2. Fixed Stage 1-7(Episode 01-Stage 07) Loading Issue

Issue with Stage 1-7 not loading properly fixed.
